name: JCB Digger / Trekk Steel Toe PU Sole Heavy Duty Safety Shoes
shortDescription: Rugged industrial safety shoes with 200J steel toe, water-resistant buff leather upper, padded bellows tongue, and self-cleaning high-traction PU sole.
overview: Built to endure the unforgiving environments associated with the iconic JCB brand, the JCB Digger/Trekk safety footwear delivers robust protection across quarries, excavation zones, and heavy fabrication shops. Built around a broad 200-Joule impact steel toe cap, it features a water-resistant, oil-tanned crazy horse buff leather upper with reinforced double-stitched stress seams. The dual-density polyurethane sole features deep, self-cleaning aggressive lug cleats designed to shed mud and grease while maintaining uncompromising traction on loose gravel and wet metal catwalks.
keyFeatures: Reinforced 200J steel toe cap with internal rubber edge cushion to prevent toe chafe
Water-resistant, heavy-gauge oil-pullup genuine buff leather construction
Padded bellows tongue stops dust, sand, and flying metal debris from entering
High-traction dual-density PU sole engineered with self-cleaning mud lugs
Thermal insulation and cold-crack resistance for demanding outdoor environments
High-density molded EVA insole with arch support for day-long foot comfort
Certified to IS 15298 (Part 2) and EN ISO 20345 standards
